title: Coordinator output record (Luna seat request)
description: One line-oriented request record emitted by the Luna coordinator seat (kusabi #524 §8, #529). The action allow-list is CLOSED: this enum is the single source of truth the parser enforces, and the future mission driver consumes only streams that parse with valid:true. Per-action body fields pass through unvalidated — the driver bounds them, not this schema.

action.description: The closed request allow-list of #524 §8. Any other verb — and in particular any verb that publishes, merges, writes an issue, spawns a container, or invokes the CLI — is rejected deterministically and counted as a coordinator error.

envelope_sha256.description: 64-char lowercase hex SHA-256 of the evidence envelope this request is bound to. A valid hash that is not the current envelope hash is rejected as envelope-mismatch (a request about stale evidence must never execute); a missing or malformed hash is a malformed record. The pattern is the actual regex ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ — evaluated by any JSON Schema validator — so it accepts every lowercase 64-hex hash and rejects uppercase, wrong-length, or non-hex strings; the code-level parser (coordinator-parse.mjs) enforces the same shape at parse time.

tool.description: read_probe's probe tool allow-list. This enum is the canonical single source of truth: the mission driver derives its PROBE_TOOL_ALLOWLIST from it and the prompt renderer states it verbatim. Nothing here can spawn a job, write a file, or run an arbitrary command — the coordinator has no tool or job-spawn authority.

path.description: read_probe's target path. Required for every probe: read_file_range and list_files read/list the path, and search_in_container scopes the search to it.

pattern.description: search_in_container's search pattern. Required when `tool` is "search_in_container": a missing, empty, or whitespace-only pattern is refused by the driver before any tool call (the driver never fabricates one).

brief.description: run_chain / rework_chain's inner-chain brief. The driver requires a non-empty `## Deliverables` section before the chain lifecycle seam is ever invoked; a brief that fails that check is refused as a coordinator error.

reason.description: Optional reason: consult_sol carries the audit-consultation reason and escalate_to_host carries the host handoff reason.

recommendation.description: finish's closed recommendation vocabulary. This enum is canonical: the mission driver derives its RECOMMENDATION_VOCABULARY from it and the prompt renderer states it verbatim. `accept` (the chain verb) is deliberately not here — the mission's terminal result is a recommendation, never an acceptance.

actions.description: Per-action body-field contract, canonical for the prompt renderer. The parser deliberately does NOT enforce these bodies (it validates only framing / action / hash and passes bodies through); the driver is the per-action enforcement boundary. The renderer derives every per-action field statement from this map, so the schema and the guidance can never drift.

read_probe.description: tool (required, closed enum) + path (required); pattern is required when tool is search_in_container.

run_chain.description: brief (required) — must carry a non-empty `## Deliverables` section.

rework_chain.description: brief (required) — must carry a non-empty `## Deliverables` section.

probe_tools.description: read_probe's per-tool argument surface, canonical for the prompt renderer: each tool's required top-level request fields and the exact argument names the driver passes to the callTool seam (the container id is always supplied by the driver — Luna never names it).

read_file_range.description: Reads a range of a file. Top-level `path` is mapped to the callTool argument `file_path`.

search_in_container.description: Searches inside the container with a regex `pattern`, scoped to `path`.

inner_brief.description: The schema-owned contract for the inner-chain brief (run_chain / rework_chain `brief`). Five frozen rules the deterministic driver enforces before any chain work starts; the coordinator prompt renderer (renderCoordinatorContract) states every rule's description verbatim from this section, so the schema and the prompt can never drift apart.

signature.description: Signature ownership: the deterministic driver owns the inner-brief signature. Luna must not invent an `Orchestrator:` line — the driver strips any `Orchestrator:` line in the first five lines and prepends exactly one canonical line 1 (model = the actual coordinator seat, session = the mission id, date = the dispatch's UTC day).

deliverables.description: Deliverables: a run_chain / rework_chain brief requires a non-empty `## Deliverables` section — a brief without one, or with a heading that parses to zero entries, is refused before any chain work starts.

smoke.description: Smoke: the `## Smoke` commands must be backtick-quoted bullets or fenced code-block lines, and an empty `## Smoke` heading is refused. A `baseline-red` annotation declares an entry expected to fail on the unmodified checkout — a measured mismatch there is the annotation doing its job.

frozen_tests.description: Frozen Tests: each `## Frozen Tests` entry is the path alone (a path-only entry) — leftover prose outside the path token is invisible to the P5 frozen oracle and is refused. Frozen Tests lists existing test files the worker must not modify (not "tests that must pass"); a test the worker should write or edit belongs in Deliverables and must never also appear in Frozen Tests (such a brief is refused).

empty_headings.description: Empty headings: an empty section must omit its heading — a `## Deliverables`, `## Smoke`, or `## Frozen Tests` heading that parses to zero entries is refused; absence is fine, emptiness is not.
